item.title: Difference makers: The purpose of everyday people
item.description: It is a simple effort, but it reflects something deeply important. A city is shaped not only by what we build, but by who we are. Meridian’s strength is found in its people, especially those who serve without recognition.

item.title: Never put off until tomorrow…unless
item.description: There’s an old saying, often attributed to Benjamin Franklin, that goes something like this, “Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.” It seems it’s sometimes attributed to Thomas Jefferson as well.

item.title: Wing Care Team looks to start conversation at CommuniTEA & Conversations
item.description: Millions of Americans are victims of sexual violence each year, yet many are ashamed or embarrassed to talk about it. On Thursday, the Key Field Air National Guard Wing Care Team, along with community resources, set up outside Cash Saver in downtown Meridian to change that with its CommuniTEA & Conversations event.

item.title: Meridian community remembers Donna Jill Johnson
item.description: Donna Jill Johnson, a cherished member of the Meridian community, passed away peacefully on Feb. 5. She was surrounded by loved ones who will forever remember her warmth, kindness, and unwavering dedication to family, friends, and her community.

item.title: Stacy Luker named new head football coach at Lamar
item.description: The Lamar Raiders are welcoming a new face to campus after the school on Friday named Stacy Luker as its next head football coach.

item.title: Our View: High-speed internet plan helps bridge the gap

item.title: Clarkdale’s McCallister signs with Hinds Community College
item.description: The Clarkdale Bulldogs football team celebrated one of their own on Friday as Bryson McCallister signed to continue playing football at Hinds Community College after graduation.
